forbidden_dependencies: source-provided bounding boxes as model inputs

frame_sampling_assumption.normalization: uint8 RGB decoded from raw video; model/training code may normalize after tensor load but must record that transform in provenance
frame_sampling_assumption.note: M3AD should bind the resolved crop_config_hash into generated manifests/tensors before any M3AE training.

coordinate_system.handedness_note: left/right regions are viewer-side fixed regions, not anatomical handedness labels.

regions.reason: Covers viewer-left signing hand plus lower signing-space context under controlled centered framing.
Covers viewer-right signing hand plus lower signing-space context under controlled centered framing.
Preserves gross two-hand and chest/torso motion for table and please while keeping shoulder/head context.
Keeps face/head location needed for dad, grandpa, and hat without using landmarks or a detector.
Retained for visual contact-sheet review and crop-quality debugging; not a substitute for the four fixed proof regions.

controlled_framing_limitations: This protocol assumes a centered signer with visible upper body and hands in PopSign game videos.
It is not robust to off-center webcam capture, seated/standing framing changes, or camera crops that remove the head/upper torso.
It does not solve final-promotion negative-challenge coverage.
If M3AD contact sheets show systematic hand/head truncation, adjust this config and re-run M3AD before any training.
If M3AE fails mainly on dad/grandpa/hat confusion, treat it as a crop/label-set remediation signal rather than permission to expand labels.
next_milestone: M3AD must generate or refresh Tier 0 manifests/tensors and prove dataloader correctness before training.
